title: Is this Change the Answer to that Problem? Correlating Descriptions of Bug and Code Changes for Evaluating Patch Correctness

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance (AUC and F1 scores) of a random forest classifier using a traditional 10-fold cross-validation scheme (which allows duplicate/semantically-equivalent patches in train and test sets) versus a custom 10-group cross-validation scheme grouped by bug IDs to measure the inflated performance caused by data leakage.

Mitigating and evaluating the impact of an imbalanced dataset (83% incorrect vs. 17% correct patches) by stressing the AUC metric over the F1 score, and testing the classifier's performance on a re-balanced 1:1 test set to observe changes in the F1 score.
